blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senate Minority Leader Alan Peter Cayetano on Sunday urged Filipinos to be “pro-Philippines” amid the latest word war between Manila and Beijing over Chinese Ambassador Jing Quan’s remarks about China’s ability to defeat the Philippines by force. Cayetano stressed that the Philippines is not looking for trouble. “[W]e are not looking for trouble…but because of the heat of our dispute with China, it spilled over now even in Congress,” Cayetano said in a Facebook livestream. “But just a reminder to all of us, don’t be pro-US, don’t be pro-China.
